clicked: Playing the 61 humanoid clips, plus custom motion.

blocks.text: The bar: a cheer the second the gate opens, at attention three seconds later. A channel plays a clip by address: ctx.self.anim.gesture = { clip: "cdn/clip-cheer-loop.glb", weight: 4, duration: 3, mask: { from: "Spine" } }. Bare names play only the body's five: Idle, Walk, Run, Sprint, Jump; every other clip is cdn/clip-<words>.glb; a -loop name cycles, any other plays once, then .finished is true and the gait resumes; null then the clip restarts it; clampWhenFinished: true keeps a death down. Library clips play at once; other words cook into motion first. A clip file: spawn clip import <file> --name "<words>" [--loop] prints its address, fitted to each body's rest pose; Blender keys copied between rigs need matching rest poses. A clip loads on first play, never from a script. The gait's one writer, on every walking body: ctx.spawn({ physics: "character", model, behavior: ["scripts/guard.js", "scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js"] }), model per art style (players: /cdn/neutral-default-avatar.glb); guard.js steers velocity and yaw to its goal (findPath), the gait playing Walk or Run at that pace, Idle at rest. The pose has one writer too: the animator writes anim and bones; others (a climb, slide, foot lock) ask through its state (ctx.self.state.climb = { ledge }, then null), answered each tick by a channel or bone beside the gait. A hand on a thing is IK on any rig: ctx.self.bones.RightHand.reach = { object: "crate", offset: { x: 0.2, y: 0.4, z: 0 } } holds it over any clip; rotation turns the hand in the crate's frame, { to, pole } bends the elbow toward pole, both inside human arm ranges, so grip where a person could, .aim turns a bone's front to a target, null lets go. A foot lock pins a planted foot where its currentWorldPosition reads, in view or not. Seat a held thing in a fist (→uploaded-models) and the hand closes; a finger named in bones keeps its pose, { pitch: 0 } too; the other hand on it, a load or ledge is a reach, never a solved joint angle. A gesture's weight 4 beats the idle's 1 per bone, its spine mask leaving legs and hips to the gait, so an aim leans on bones.Spine.pitch; a pose replacing the gait (sit, sleep, swim) stands it down first: a body parented to a seat sits by itself.
